skill.name: impeccable
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong UX and visual quality. Use craft mode to build, teach mode to gather context, and extract mode for design systems.
skill.summary: Build distinctive frontend interfaces and reusable design patterns with context-aware guidance.
skill.author: pbakaus

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown design guidance, CSS examples, or JavaScript template literals. The material risk is the post-update cleanup flow: the skill directs the agent to run a Node script that can delete local skill directories and edit skills-lock.json. No evidence found of prompt injection that tries to bypass this audit.

remediation.issue: Automatic cleanup command before design work
remediation.suggestion: Make cleanup opt-in. Show the exact target paths and require explicit user confirmation before running the script.

remediation.issue: Destructive filesystem operations in cleanup script
remediation.suggestion: Use dry-run mode by default. Delete only entries with exact manifest ownership and avoid removing dangling symlinks without confirmation.
Remove the instruction to edit SKILL.md after execution. Use versioned installer migration metadata instead.

content.value_statement: Generic AI interfaces look repetitive and unfinished. Impeccable gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured design guidance for polished frontend work.
actual_capabilities: Guides design context gathering before frontend work.
Provides craft, teach, and extract workflows for UI projects.
Loads focused references for typography, color, spacing, motion, interaction, responsive design, and UX writing.
Defines concrete anti-patterns for generic AI-looking interfaces.
Helps extract reusable components and tokens into an existing design system.
Includes cleanup tooling for deprecated skill names and lock-file entries.
limitations: It requires project and audience context before design work.
It does not replace browser-based visual review.
The bundled cleanup script can modify local skill folders when run.
It provides guidance, not complete framework-specific design system automation.

use_cases.title: Design a new product screen
use_cases.description: Create a complete frontend screen with layout, typography, responsive behavior, interaction states, and visual polish.

use_cases.title: Capture project design context
use_cases.description: Collect audience, brand, accessibility, and aesthetic decisions before generating interface work.

use_cases.title: Extract reusable UI patterns
use_cases.description: Identify repeated components and tokens, then plan their migration into an existing design system.

prompt_templates.title: Gather design context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a project without a design brief.

prompt_templates.title: Craft a focused component
prompt_templates.scenario: Build one user-facing interface element with clear context.
prompt_templates.prompt: /impeccable craft Build a pricing comparison section for independent consultants. The tone should feel precise, confident, and warm.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an existing screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a current frontend view while keeping product behavior intact.
prompt_templates.prompt: /impeccable craft Redesign the onboarding checklist screen. Keep the same actions, but improve hierarchy, responsive behavior, empty states, and accessibility.

prompt_templates.title: Extract design system patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for teams consolidating repeated UI work.
prompt_templates.prompt: /impeccable extract Review the settings area and identify reusable components, semantic tokens, naming conventions, and a safe migration path.

output_examples.input: Build a checkout progress interface for a mobile commerce app.
output_examples.output: A responsive checkout stepper with clear hierarchy, accessible focus states, useful loading behavior, and concise error copy.

output_examples.input: Improve a dashboard that looks generic and card-heavy.
output_examples.output: A refined dashboard direction with stronger spacing, typography, fewer redundant cards, clearer data priority, and responsive layouts.

output_examples.input: Extract reusable patterns from repeated account settings screens.
output_examples.output: A migration plan for shared form rows, action groups, status messages, spacing tokens, and documentation updates.

best_practices: Provide audience, use case, brand tone, and accessibility requirements before craft mode.
Verify primary, loading, empty, error, and responsive states in a browser.
Review any cleanup action before allowing local file deletion.
anti_patterns: Running the cleanup script without checking which files it may remove.
Asking for a modern look without audience, tone, or constraints.
Treating the first generated pass as final without visual review.

faq.question: What does Impeccable help with?
faq.answer: It helps create distinctive frontend interfaces with stronger layout, typography, interaction states, responsive behavior, and UX writing.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it need design context?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for audience, use case, brand tone, and other context before design work.

faq.question: Can it update files?
faq.answer: Yes. Teach mode can write design context, and the cleanup script can modify local skill folders and lock files.

faq.question: Does it replace visual QA?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly expects browser review, state checks, and responsive testing after implementation.

faq.question: What should I review before installing?
faq.answer: Review the post-update cleanup flow because it can run a Node script that deletes deprecated local skill entries.
